the Tabernacle itself was ten cubits [high]: 'ten cubits the length of the board' (Ex 26:16)
'and he spread the tent over the Tabernacle' (Ex 40:19) -- Rav: Moses our teacher spread it
from here you learn that the height of the Levites was ten cubits
and we have it by tradition: every load carried on poles -- a third is above [the bearer] and two thirds below
the Ark was nine [handbreadths] and the cover a handbreadth: here are ten

the Shekhina rests only upon one who is wise, mighty, rich and tall

version 1's ground: for the people of Hutzal do so

version 2's ground: for the people of his town do so
an individual's [or a town's] way is void beside the way of all people
version 3: one who carries out a load on his head is exempt
and if you say the people of Hutzal do so -- their way is void beside all people
